  "CRITERIA_MATCH_EXPLANATION": "This paper discusses curriculum harmonization in medical education across multiple African countries, specifically focusing on the East African Community (EAC).   "Title": "Competency-based education in undergraduate medical curricula in East Africa: a scoping review",
  "Authors": [
    "Nazarius Mbona Tumwesigye",
    "Rose Chalo Nabirye",
    "Imelda Namagembe",
    "Paul Kiondo",
    "Francis Omaswa",
    "Nelson K. Sewankambo"
  ],
  "Year": "2023",

      "Students"

      "Availability of resources",
